title: Among superheroes published by Marvel Comics, identify the fastest hero and
question: Among superheroes published by Marvel Comics, identify the fastest hero and report their full name along with the total count of all heroes who share the same maximum speed value.

prediction.sql:
WITH marvel_speed AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_018, s.XCL_020, ha.XCL_011
    FROM superhero AS s
    INNER JOIN publisher AS p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    WHERE p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND a.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
),
max_speed AS (
    SELECT MAX(XCL_011) AS max_speed_value
    FROM marvel_speed
),
fastest AS (
    SELECT ms.XCL_018, ms.XCL_020
    FROM marvel_speed AS ms
    INNER JOIN max_speed AS m ON ms.XCL_011 = m.max_speed_value
),
shared_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM marvel_speed
    WHERE XCL_011 = (SELECT max_speed_value FROM max_speed)
)
SELECT f.XCL_020, sc.cnt
FROM fastest AS f
CROSS JOIN shared_count AS sc

fastest AS (

shared_count AS (

)
SELECT f.XCL_020, sc.cnt

CROSS JOIN shared_count AS sc
